annotations.title: Get restatement delta between two filings

description:
Compare two filings that report one statement and return the per-metric changes between them (old, new and diff for each canonical metric that changed).

Name the two filings with `from_accession` and `to_accession`, the SEC accession numbers of the filings. Each resolves to the statement that filing reports.

With neither, the earliest-accepted filing for the period is compared with the latest one: the net change from first report to now. A period that was never restated returns no deltas, with both ends naming the same filing. This default moves when a new amendment is filed; pass accessions for a result that stays fixed.

Only metrics both filings carry are diffed. Metrics only one filing carries are listed in `metrics_only_in_from` and `metrics_only_in_to`, and `comparability_warning` is true when either list is not empty.

Giving only one side of the pair returns 400. The `from` filing must have been accepted by the SEC before the `to` filing. An accession that reports no statement for this cik, statement type and period returns 404, listing the accessions the period does have. `from_version` and `to_version` in the response name the filings that were compared.

cik.description: Company CIK as digits (for example 0000320193). Send this or `ticker`, not both.

fiscal_period.description: Fiscal period code (e.g., FY, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4).

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year for the statement identity.

from_accession.description: SEC accession of the filing to compare from, resolved to the statement that filing reports. Give together with to_accession. Omit both accessions to compare the earliest-accepted filing with the latest; that default moves when a new amendment is filed, so pass accessions for a fixed result.

statement_date.description: End date of the statement's period (YYYY-MM-DD). Names the period to compare when the identity reports more than one: a fiscal year split at a business combination or fresh-start reorganization is reported as two OTHER periods, and each is compared across filings on its own. Without it the comparison covers the later period. A date that names no period of the identity answers 404, listing the dates in `details.available_statement_dates`.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol naming the company, in place of `cik`; send one or the other. Resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none.

to_accession.description: SEC accession of the filing to compare to, resolved to the statement that filing reports. Give together with from_accession. Omit both accessions to compare the earliest-accepted filing with the latest; that default moves when a new amendment is filed, so pass accessions for a fixed result.
